flawless: Under my moon every land is a mountain, and every mountain is mine.
Your fancy lands turned to rock, and so did your hopes.
The red moon rose, and you never saw daylight.
solid: You found mana where I left none. Clever. Not enough.
Moonlight has sharp edges. You found a few of them.
close: The moon nearly set on me. You fought by stubborn starlight.
I have never been so glad of a mountain under my feet.
